name: Conor Lamb
summary: Conor James Lamb (born June 27, 1984) is an American attorney and politician who served as a U.S. representative from 2018 to 2023. A member of the Democratic Party, he briefly represented the Pennsylvania's 18th congressional district following a special election in 2018 and then won full terms to represent the 17th district in 2018 and 2020. He left the House to run for the U.S. Senate.
